prompt:
A horizontal strip of pixel art showing the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised wall/ledge, exactly as such faces look in a top-down JRPG map (we look straight at the face; it is the drop between an upper level and the floor). It fills the whole image edge to edge: the top 6% is the lit rim/lip of the upper surface, the face below gets gradually darker toward the bottom, and the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where it meets the floor. No floor, no sky, no objects in front. SEAMLESS horizontally (left edge continues into the right edge). The strip is about 256 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels). Material: icy rock cliff with a thick snow cornice on the top lip, icicles and frosted strata
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
revised_prompt: Create a single horizontal, edge-to-edge tileable game-environment texture: the straight-on VERTICAL FRONT FACE of an elevated icy-rock cliff/ledge in a top-down JRPG map, not a view of the cliff from above. Wide 2:1 canvas, designed as 256x128 art pixels enlarged with perfectly sharp nearest-neighbor square pixels (uniform approximately 7–8 screen pixels per art pixel). The entire frame is filled by the ledge face. At the very top, only about 6% of image height, a brightly lit thick snow cornice/rim forming the upper lip; beneath it long and short chunky icicles and layered frosted icy-rock strata descend vertically, with coherent chunky rectangular pixel clusters. Face grows gradually darker toward bottom, with the final 8% a dark continuous contact band. No visible upper horizontal ground plane, no lower floor, no horizon, sky, characters, or foreground objects. Make the texture HORIZONTALLY SEAMLESS: structures, stripes, snow and dark band must continue precisely and naturally at left/right edges. Premium modern hand-placed hi-bit JRPG pixel art; crisp uniform square pixels, strong deliberate clusters of 3–10 pixels, sharp hard-edged shapes, no anti-aliasing, smoothing, blur, soft brushes, photorealistic texture, random noise, or checkerboard dithering. Limited 4–6 shade ramps for snow, ice, and rocky strata, subtle hue-shifted palette: creamy pale yellow-white highlights, blue-slate ice midtones, saturated violet/plum and muted reddish-purple shadows. Rich earthy lived-in colour. Neutral soft even upper-left daylight as under calm overcast evening, clean base colors: no cast shadows, night effect, directional spotlights, glow, vignette, or light pools. A reusable side-facing cliff wall sprite texture, flat orthographic elevation.
